name: Document
description: Create documents and charts, and deliver downloadable conversation artifacts.
progressive_guidance: Use document.create for local editable Word files, typst.compile for local PDFs and document page images, and echarts.render with native ECharts JSON options for data charts. Charts are separate SVG/PNG artifacts that can be embedded in documents or media projects. Hosted document generation uses configured profile defaults. Prefer the document-authoring skill, inspect the resulting content and layout, and revise before delivery.
